roots_note: Absolute or project-relative paths to document trees to index. Local folders and synced cloud folders (e.g. Dropbox/OneDrive mounts) both work.

embeddings.note: Example for a Chinese corpus only. The deploying agent must replace body_model, bge_base_model, and bge_small_model after asking whether the files are Chinese, English, or mixed. See docs/models.md.

features.note: fts is always on. Minimal profile: vectors only (or none). Full: all true.

hosts.build_note: Build host holds canonical indexes (FTS + vectors + desc + media + OCR).
hosts.query_note: Grok default: set build_host and query_index_dir to the user's Grok cloud computer and search that copy. Other agents: leave these empty and query on the build machine.

allow_remote_note: Keep false. true + --i-understand-remote is required for saas or non-localhost providers; document content leaves the machine.

llm.note: Example only: Ollama + Qwen. Replace type and model with the local instruct model the user already runs (LM Studio, Ollama, Gemma, Qwen, or Llama). For saas set api_key_env (env var NAME, never the key).

embedding.note: Example for Chinese text. Ask the user, then set zh, en, or bge-m3 from docs/models.md. Changing model requires rebuilding vectors.
